description: Delete all existing Android-specific files and set up the Expo React Native project scaffolding with proper package.json, tsconfig, app.json, and directory structure
steps: Delete ALL existing Android files: app/ directory, build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts, gradle/ directory, gradlew, gradlew.bat, .agents/ task files (keep .git)

Create package.json with all dependencies: expo ~51.0.0, expo-router ~3.5.0, expo-av ~14.0.0, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage ~1.23.0, react-native, react, typescript, @expo/vector-icons, expo-status-bar, react-native-safe-area-context, react-native-screens, expo-linking, expo-constants, expo-font
Create tsconfig.json extending expo/tsconfig.base with strict mode
Create app.json with Expo config: name 'AI Tajweed Ustoz', slug 'tajweed-ustoz', scheme 'tajweed', iOS/Android config, plugins for expo-router and expo-av
Create babel.config.js with expo preset and expo-router/babel plugin
Create app/_layout.tsx as root layout with expo-router Stack/Tabs navigation
Create app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx with bottom tab navigation (Home, Darslar, Quran, Mashq, Progress)
Create placeholder screens: app/(tabs)/index.tsx, app/(tabs)/lessons.tsx, app/(tabs)/quran.tsx, app/(tabs)/practice.tsx, app/(tabs)/progress.tsx
Create app/settings.tsx and app/lesson/[id].tsx, app/quran/[surahNumber].tsx, app/practice/[ruleId].tsx, app/recording.tsx, app/feedback/[id].tsx as stack screens
Create src/ directory structure: src/data/, src/services/, src/contexts/, src/components/, src/constants/
Create .gitignore for Node/Expo project (node_modules, .expo, dist, etc.)
acceptance_criteria: No Android-specific files remain (no app/build.gradle.kts, no gradle/, no .kt files)
package.json exists with all required Expo dependencies
app.json exists with proper Expo configuration
src/ directory structure exists with data/, services/, contexts/, components/, constants/ subdirectories
verification: Verify no .kt, .gradle, .gradle.kts files exist in the project
Verify package.json is valid JSON with correct dependency versions
Verify all expected files exist by listing the directory tree
